content.title: Capital Improvement Plan
content.summary: The City of Arvada's Capital Improvement Plan (CIP) outlines a strategic approach for capital maintenance and investments over the next decade, updated every two years alongside the budget cycle. The current CIP can be reviewed in the 2025-2026 Biennial Operating and Capital Budget document, with past plans accessible through Munidocs.
content.body: The City of Arvada Capital Improvement Plan (CIP) represents two years of a new comprehensive CIP plan that encompasses a long-term and strategic approach for the City's capital maintenance and capital investments for the next decade. The plan is updated in its entirety with each two-year budget cycle. Review the [current Capital Improvement plans beginning on page 153 of the 2025-2026 Biennial Operating and Capital Budget document](https://www.arvadaco.gov/235/Budget). Past CIPs are available to review in [Munidocs](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/munidocs/munidocs?nodeId=6876616fb5ed5).
